verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at exa.ai/llms.txt and Markdown versions of the docs (e.g. search-api-guide.md) that point agents to a full documentation index at /docs/llms.txt. Further .md doc pages and official agent skills that teach coding agents how to use Exa's APIs round out the agent-oriented docs. missing for 10: independent community corroboration of agents consuming these docs, and evidence of a fuller llms-full.txt-style export.
